scope: Semantic content library with original layout; not a binary/frame-layout replica.

sections.note: 32 original animal variants, including juvenile animals, sheared sheep, pets, dinosaur and horse; four idle directions, two left walking frames, two grazing frames.
24 independently designed farm exteriors: all farm building functions, obelisks and four farmhouse upgrade stages; new designs and emblems.
64 original role-based villagers, eight poses each; no identities copied from existing named characters.
32 original creatures, four poses each; includes all documented monster types plus two original additions.
Original male/female farmer action drafts and cosmetic layers. New frame layout, not a replacement for the external game's layered rendering system.
Use Godot runtime system-font fallback and five text style roles instead of generating unreliable CJK bitmap pages. No external font image copied.
Blank UI backgrounds and runtime labels, cursors/states/emotes/buffs, lighting, shadows, map/noticeboard/sky equivalents; localizations deduplicated.
Same seasonal columns for spring/summer/autumn/winter; original ground textures, street modules and beach props.
Nine mine biome/light variants with eight tile/prop types; root Mines duplicates represented once.
Modular interior surfaces plus original environment/story backdrops. Scene panels are backgrounds, not prebuilt playable maps.
sections.reference_count_note: Part of the documented Maps/ total of 126 files; localized duplicates are not counted as separate content.

sections.note: Original title/intro/cloud/logo/leaflet/cart/board-game artwork and backgrounds; text remains runtime data.
44 original characters with six base expressions and extra expressions for the high-expression groups (up to twelve).
Trees/seasons/stumps/growth, orchard stages, soil/floors, cave walls/stalagmites/crystals/plants and status symbols.

24 additional crops with six stages, six fruit tree types, 64 machines, 64 furnishings, tools/weapons/materials/food/forage/effects; existing original fish and crop libraries referenced, never the external pack. The source 816-cell sheet includes variants/empty slots; this is a semantic library, not 816 guessed item IDs.
56 localized copies and repeated map images are consolidated into original unlabelled artwork plus Godot localized text.
